process.heading: Buy property search to legal transfer
process.subtitle: Under Property Plan (جائیداد کا منصوبہ): search → details → contact → document verify → price → legal transfer.

0.title: Search
0.text: Search residential, commercial, agricultural land or future construction projects by need and budget.

1.title: View details
1.text: Review listing information, location, type and available documents on the platform.

2.title: Contact
2.text: Contact the seller or a property representative / partner in the company network.

3.title: Verify documents
3.text: Personally verify ownership and related documents before agreeing terms.

4.title: Agree price
4.text: Negotiate and finalize price with clear disclosure of commission where applicable.

5.title: Legal transfer
5.text: Complete the transfer according to legal requirements and company process.

scope.heading: What you can buy or sell
scope.residentialText: Homes and residential properties listed through the organized Property Plan marketplace.
scope.commercialText: Commercial property opportunities with verification and legal transfer process.
scope.agriText: Agricultural land listings for buyers and sellers under company verification.
scope.projectsText: Future construction / development projects connected through representatives and partners.

commission.heading: Transparent commission per deal
commission.text: Commission is disclosed for each deal. Example: about 2% e.g. a 1 Crore deal may involve about 2 Lakh commission. Exact rates depend on the deal and company terms.

autoSaving.heading: Auto saving may apply
autoSaving.text: After an eligible property purchase through the company system, designated amount may enter the automatic saving and lucky draw system.

disclaimer.title: Important Clarification
disclaimer.text: Buyers are responsible for verifying documents and completing legal transfer requirements. Platform information is not final legal proof of ownership. Commission figures are examples. Auto saving and draws follow company terms. Property Saving is also known as جائیداد کا منصوبہ (Property Plan).
